verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a self-hosted or desktop AI workspace, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that AnythingLLM runs locally, can be self-hosted with Docker, and exposes an API. Local data residency and API primitives are adjacent building blocks, not a documented export-all-data-in-open-formats feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
